sequence: No PartSmith Setup or PCB inspection window was running.
Started KiCad project manager and inspected its PCM Installed tab, selecting PartSmith.
Opened the owned probe project PCB Editor.
Clicked the installed PS toolbar action in PCB Editor.
Selected the already open owned board in the action chooser.
PartSmith Setup and PCB inspection appeared; official live IPC inspection was READY.
caveat: This confirms the installed 0.1.4 normal launch path. It does not validate later icon package versions or close Phase 13.2.
